exercises.question: Choose the grammar pattern that matches: "To Quote or Define".

options.text: A とか B とか
A は B ほど～ありません
A は B ほど～ない

exercises.correctFeedback: Great! ～という matches "To Quote or Define".
exercises.incorrectFeedback: Not quite. The correct pattern is ～という.
exercises.explanation: Used to quote, report, or define information or names in sentences.
